description: Crypto positioning for trading agents, per call, for BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP and DOGE: funding on the Binance and Bybit perpetual markets and the gap between them, open interest on both, a positioning signal (crowded longs, crowded shorts, a real cross-venue funding gap, or neutral), and POSITIONING STRESS: funding, open interest and the 24h move each against the coin's own last 30 days, in standard deviations. Descriptive, not a forecast. Large confirmed BTC transactions from the latest block for BTC.

asset.description: Asset ticker e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL (default BTC).

symbol.description: Optional explicit perp symbol e.g. BTCUSDT.
